answer: Require every identity to lock 145 POA for 50 epochs and complete eleven unpredictable jobs per round, with an 11-of-19 established jury signing replayable receipts. One missed round freezes rewards; two slash 75% of the sable bond. Funding-linked entrants cross a mesa where each new bond doubles, making clone costs geometric. The ledger verifies task hashes, quorum signatures, timestamps, and funding ancestry; a prism similarity test links copied outputs to the higher tier.
